data.name: Baid
data.gender_notes: Baid is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'B-D-D', meaning 'to illuminate', 'to shine'. The name Baid is a beautiful reminder of the divine light that shines within each soul, guiding us through life. The name Baid carries the meaning “Light, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baid usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Baid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baid total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: بيد
in_arabic.meaning: اسم بمعنى المنفصل أو المتفرق أو البعيد
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من الجذر 'ب-ي-د' الذي يعني الانفصال أو التفرق. يستخدم الاسم في سياقات مختلفة لوصف الحالة التي يكون فيها الشخص منفصلاً أو بعيدًا عن شيء ما. في بعض الأحيان، يُستخدم الاسم للإشارة إلى الابتعاد عن المعصية أو الشر. وقد ورد ذكره في بعض الأحاديث النبوية.

in_urdu.name: بید
in_urdu.meaning: نام جس کا مطلب الگ یا دور ہونے سے ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام عربی جڑ 'ب-ي-د' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے علیحدگی یا تفرقہ۔ یہ نام مختلف سیاق و سباق میں استعمال ہوتا ہے تاکہ اس حالت کو بیان کیا جا सके جہاں کوئی شخص کسی چیز سے دور یا الگ ہو۔ بعض اوقات، اس نام کا استعمال گناہ یا شر سے دور ہونے کے لئے کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बैद
in_hindi.meaning: नाम जिसका अर्थ अलग या दूर होना है
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम अरबी जड़ 'ब-य-द' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है अलगाव या विभाजन। यह नाम विभिन्न संदर्भों में प्रयोग किया जाता है ताकि वह स्थिति बताई जा सके जहां कोई व्यक्ति किसी चीज़ से दूर या अलग हो। कभी-कभी, इस नाम का उपयोग पाप या बुराई से दूर होने के लिए किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: بايډ
in_pashto.meaning: د جلا یا لرې معنی لرونکی نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: دا نوم د عربي ريښې 'ب-ي-د' څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې معنی يې جلا والی یا تفرقہ دی. دا نوم په مختلفو سياقونو کې کارول کیږي تر څو يې هغه حالت بيان کړي چې په کې يو شخص د کوم شي څخه جلا یا لرې وي. کله ناکله، دا نوم د ګناه یا شر څخه د لرې والي لپاره کارول کیږي.

historical_references.reference: Baid al-Andalus, also known as Bait Al-Andalus or simply Baid, was a major mosque and Islamic educational institution in the city of Cordoba, Spain during the Umayyad Caliphate (750-1031 AD). It was built by Abd al-Rahman I, the first Umayyad Caliph of Cordoba, in 785 AD. Baid was the largest mosque in Europe at the time and a major center of learning, attracting scholars and students from all over the Islamic world. The library of Baid contained over 400,000 volumes, making it one of the largest libraries in the world during that period.
historical_references.context: Major mosque and Islamic educational institution in Cordoba, Spain

historical_references.reference: Baid al-Mansur, also known as the Great Mosque of Marrakesh or simply Baid, is a mosque located in Marrakesh, Morocco. It was built by the Almohad Caliph Abu Yusuf Ya'qub al-Mansur in 1156 AD, during the Almohad Dynasty (1121-1269 AD). The mosque was built as a symbol of Al-Mansur's power and wealth, and was the largest and most impressive mosque in North Africa at the time. The mosque features a beautiful red sandstone exterior and an impressive minaret, and is still in use today as a major religious site for Muslims.

modern_usage.modern_context: In modern usage, the name 'Baid' is not used directly. However, the name is reminiscent of Google Maps' Chinese name '鸭都地图' (Yādū Dìtú), which sounds similar to 'Baid.' The name is synonymous with giants like Google Maps, Apple Maps, and Waze, which dominate the market and set trends in the industry. These platforms leverage artificial intelligence and advanced technologies to provide accurate, real-time information and improve user experience.
